en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a substantial corner building in a European city. The three‑story stone structure has arched ground‑floor windows and doors, decorative cornices, and many upper‑floor windows with awnings. Swedish text identifying an insurance company is painted along the facade. In the foreground is an iron bridge or railing over water with decorative circles, a lamppost, and a small kiosk-like structure on the right. Printed red text along the bottom identifies the city and company name.
